explanation: The statement concerns the library's own `homologyEulerChar`, which takes values in `AbelianK0 A` (the Grothendieck group of an abelian category). Mathlib's only `homologyEulerChar` is `HomologicalComplex.homologyEulerChar`, in `Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/EulerCharacteristic.lean`. It is defined for complexes of R-modules and takes values in ℤ, using `finrank`. The only lemma it has there is the finsum-to-finite-sum comparison, which is a different result. I found no Mathlib lemma about quasi-isomorphism invariance of any Euler characteristic.
